commands:
set -euo pipefail
export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"
export PATH="$HOME/.gradle/local-agent/gradle-9.6.0/bin:$PATH"
EXPECTED_MAIN=d02bb3537be8a99762bf1264a4691ef06c7879ad
EXPECTED_WORK=e1379246ba5c07993101b447fb3760183853fe40
EXPECTED_GATE_A=5596760ecdc21bd6361cd3e849011f24bf24a387
git fetch origin main agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path agent/gate-a-ready-to-dial
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED_MAIN"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path)" = "$EXPECTED_WORK"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/agent/gate-a-ready-to-dial)" = "$EXPECTED_GATE_A"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git checkout -B main origin/main
git merge --squash origin/agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path
git diff --check
test ! -e scripts/apply_chat_relay_tx_pacing_v2.py
bash scripts/verify_host.sh
git diff --check
git add -A
git commit -m 'feat: add interactive ChatGPT relay benchmark path'
FINAL_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
git push origin HEAD:main
git fetch origin main
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$FINAL_SHA"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git merge-base --is-ancestor "$EXPECTED_GATE_A" origin/main
git push origin --delete agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path agent/gate-a-ready-to-dial
git fetch --prune origin
test -z "$(git ls-remote --heads origin 'refs/heads/agent/*')"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo chatgpt_relay_finalize_main_green=true
echo final_main_sha=$FINAL_SHA
